- The ANC wins a majority of votes in South African elections, ensuring that Zuma will be the country's next president.
Zuma secures a second term as president, with the ANC winning a majority of votes.
Zuma avoids a vote of no-confidence in parliament, with 214 votes against the motion, 126 for and 58 abstentions.
A motion of no-confidence in Zuma is defeated by 198 votes to 177.
